verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a public Administration REST API, and the Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) exposes the same operations over that API for scripted management of realms, users, roles and clients. Programmatic access is also documented through standard OIDC endpoints (well-known discovery, introspection, revocation, dynamic client registration), client-credentials service accounts, per-realm SCIM endpoints and the Authorization Services Protection API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and hands-on reports describe inconsistent Admin API behavior (incomplete GET payloads, POST/update save quirks) that makes idempotent automation hard.
